title: Gemma 2 Release
summary: Google's official Gemma release log records June 27, 2024 as the initial release of Gemma 2 in 9B and 27B sizes. Google's Gemma 2 model card describes the family as open-weight, text-to-text, decoder-only language models.
significance: A dated release milestone in Google's Gemma open-model family for the initial 9B and 27B Gemma 2 variants.

verification.note: Google's official Gemma release log directly records June 27, 2024 as the initial Gemma 2 release in 9B and 27B sizes.
